title: More Diamond In Your World
description: A resourcepack that makes diamonds in your world appear more prominent
body:
This is a funny prank texture pack that swaps the textures and names of diamond ore and glow lichen. It also adds an emissive texture (self-illuminating effect) to glow lichen in diamond form (using shaders).
![On the left is a diamond, and on the right is a luminescent lichen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21ff408ae40de99939491b0e8c42c111d8e1cd08.png)
